verdict.rationale: Docs confirm NVLink-connected multi-GPU configs (up to 4 GPUs via NVLink for H200 NVL, HGX H200 systems with 4/8 GPUs), rack-scale certified partner systems, and HBM3e bandwidth improvements aimed at LLM training/inference at scale; community evidence corroborates real-world production deployment (Llama 405B at 142 tok/s on H200 SXM). Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of full rack-scale NVLink/Infinity Fabric topology and no explicit mention of Infinity Fabric (NVIDIA uses NVLink/NVSwitch terminology, not AMD's Infinity Fabric), plus no detailed cluster-scale networking (InfiniBand/Quantum) documentation in this pack.
